summary: BI-F9EE05E5 (slice A of the upgrade-waits-for-work plan, spec §11a). QuiescenceRun gains abortRequestedAt and abortRequestedBy, mirroring shipForceEscalatedAt/By. An operator Abort of a self-upgrade drain is written here before any wake-up event is sent, so an Abort the job engine dropped (it delivers only to a step already waiting) still ends the drain and is never followed by a swap. Additive: two nullable columns, no backfill. The model's existing lifecycle (telemetry-bounded, 90d) applies unchanged. Migration: 20260930180000_quiescence_run_abort_request.

fields.name: abortRequestedAt
fields.reason: When an operator pressed Abort on a running drain. Coordination audit timestamp; inherits the row's 90-day telemetry retention.
fields.provenance: Written once by abortQuiescence (recordDrainAbort) from the authenticated operator action; NULL when no Abort was pressed.

fields.name: abortRequestedBy
fields.reason: Which operator pressed Abort, for the run's audit trail; the same kind of operator user id already stored in shipForceEscalatedBy. Inherits the row's 90-day telemetry retention.
fields.provenance: The operator user id from requireOpsAccess, written once by abortQuiescence (recordDrainAbort).
